Summary: Mid-market UX/product company building in-app onboarding copilots. Primary pilot is a guided flow assistant that walks new users through feature discovery and account setup. They want hosted API to move quickly, then evaluate Dedicated once SLAs and unit economics are proven.

Timeline (highlights):
- 2026-02-05: Intro call (owner Elliot). Discussed architecture + use case. CTO (A. Rao) emphasized consistent latency for in-product flows.
- 2026-02-18: Demo of Redwood hosted streaming + tool calling. Product team liked streaming responsiveness; asked about tool call reliability to internal onboarding APIs. (ff_20260218_3f6g)
- 2026-02-25: Submitted security questionnaire. Awaiting KMS integration guidance. (drive:/NimbusNudge/Security_Questionnaire_2026-02.xlsx)
- 2026-03-02: Pre-POC call to scope performance tests. Agreed on 2-week POC simulating 10k MAU with peak bursts. Recorded conversation: ff_20260302_8a9b0c.
- 2026-03-04: Demo follow-up; engineering asked for p99 ≤ 300ms for incremental tokens during streaming; prefer p50 < 120ms.

Requirements / constraints (from engineering + product):
- Workload: chat/agent inside product — guided multi-turn flows that call internal touchpoint APIs (tool calling).
- Latency SLO: p99 streaming token latency target ≤ 300ms; strict UX requirement for onboarding flow.
- Cost caps: want cost-per-onboarding-session under $0.04 (token caps + model selection important).
- Session limits: expect ~400–800 tokens per session; want hard caps and early-termination fallback to smaller model or cached reply if budget reached.
- Model preferences: prefer open Llama-style variants for cost, but want Redwood-verified fast quantized builds; fallback to tiny/verbatim model for degraded mode.
- Routing: need region-aware routing (NA primary) and automated fallback to Dedicated pool if hosted capacity constrained.
- Observability: token-level cost breakdown, per-route latency traces, and regression alerts tied to sample prompts.
- Security: SSO/SAML for admin + audit logs; KMS for encryption at rest; limited data residency requirement (customer data stays in NA).

POC scope (agreed):
- 2-week hosted POC: integrate streaming chat + tool calling hooks, run traffic replay at 5× expected load, measure p50/p95/p99 and token cost.
- Test cases: normal onboarding, edge-case flows (500 session concurrency bursts), tool call failures (simulate 5% error) and validate graceful fallback.
- Deliverables: perf report, cost projection, recommended batching/cache and quant profiles, and runbook for Dedicated cutover.

Commercial notes:
- Pricing sensitivity — finance flagged ARR threshold for Dedicated commit. They asked for a pricing model with burst credits and a clear migration path (hosted -> Dedicated).
- Estimated ARR if roll to Dedicated: $150k–$250k/year depending on commitment and observed token rates.
